_doc: Harness defaults. save: the name of a save in save_library (one folder per save: caption.sav, progress.sav, save.json with its expect_spawn); before the boot every slot of the game's save folder is deleted and that save is copied into slot_01, and the folder is left so (keep saves that matter in the library). A save not in the library is taken as the map name in a save's caption (caption.sav), as Area/Map or just Map; the newest save with it is loaded (the Load list is newest first). expect_spawn: for a map name, where Link must stand after the load, or null to skip the check (a library save has its own in save.json). save_index: set to a number (0 = newest) to pick that Load-list position instead of looking up a map name. session_name: shown in the Lichii window title with the scenario, attempt and step. end_white_max: for runs of this save, the share of clipped-white pixels (percent of the scene outside the HUD) above which the end picture counts as corrupted; a spec's own end_white_max overrides it, and runs of another save use only the spec's. cube_check: for runs of this save, how many frame captures to read the lighting cube from after the end picture (the check for the corrupted-lighting boots of KNOWN-ISSUES KI-29, about a minute a run); 0 = off, the default. Set 8 here to have it on every run again when such boots come back, or "cube_check": 8 in one spec; see the harness README.
